source.title: spec automation/service_ledger v3: one door settle_service for the money path (receipt, gate, books, delivery)
source.body:
Owner's principle of 2026-10-23, in two halves: every service this project sells
emits a receipt, one splitter reads it, and the distribution is decided by rules
alone -- and all the accounting is settled without any person taking part.

This issue closes the money path on paper: service_ledger v1..v3 (four services,
one receipt gate, books derived from entries, and `settle_service` as the single
door), token-wallet v2 (the three-unit trade) and payout's `trade_split_fits`.

## Boundary

- specs/automation/service_ledger.t27
- specs/automation/token-wallet.t27
- specs/verified/payout.t27
- .trinity/seals/automation_automation::service_ledger.json
- .trinity/seals/automation_automation::token_wallet.json
- .trinity/seals/verified_VerifiedPayout.json
- docs/now/

## Goal

One spec-owned door (`settle_service`) that settles any of the four services in a
fixed order -- books-STOP, receipt gate, payout eligibility, books arithmetic,
delivery -- answering SETTLE_STOP / SETTLE_NONE / SETTLE_HOLD / SETTLE_PAY.

## Why this matters

Until v3 the rules lived in separate functions, so a host could call them in the
wrong order (pay before the gate, accrue before eligibility). One door makes the
order impossible to bypass, and HOLD separates "earned but not payable today"
from "not earned".

## Source of truth

- specs/automation/service_ledger.t27 (new)
- specs/automation/token-wallet.t27
- specs/verified/payout.t27

## Deliverable

- specs/automation/service_ledger.t27 v3: `settle_service`, `SETTLE_*` verdicts,
  books (`BOOK_STOP`), accrual only on `payout()==PAY_NORMAL`, flags
  (COMPLETION_HOST_EXISTS=false, BOOKS_HOST_EXISTS=false, TRI_PAYABLE=false).
- specs/automation/token-wallet.t27 v2: TRADE_UNITS 3, SHARE_HOUSE/BOUNTY/REFERRAL,
  trade_charged/trade_share/trade_split_fits.
- specs/verified/payout.t27: `trade_split_fits` refusal (subtract-not-add).
- Seals for all three specs regenerated.

## User Scenarios

Given a course completion receipt that passed the gate and books that read clean,
when `settle_service` runs with TRI_PAYABLE=false, then the verdict is SETTLE_HOLD
-- the accrual stands, nothing leaves.

Given unreadable books, when `settle_service` runs for any service, then the
verdict is SETTLE_STOP before any gate or payout check is consulted.

Given a receipt that payout() refuses (unverified or unreferenced), when
`settle_service` runs, then the verdict is SETTLE_NONE and no book entry exists.

## Requirements

- FR-001: `settle_service` MUST run the chain in the fixed order books-STOP,
  receipt gate, payout eligibility, books arithmetic, delivery, and no caller
  path may reorder it.
- FR-002: an accrual entry MUST exist only where `payout(...)` answers PAY_NORMAL;
  a slash or any refusal MUST accrue nothing.
- FR-003: an unreadable or inconsistent book MUST stop the run (BOOK_STOP /
  SETTLE_STOP) and MUST NOT read as "nothing was owed".
- FR-004: HOLD MUST be reachable only when the books already say PAY; a zero
  balance with a non-payable unit MUST be NONE, never HOLD.
- FR-005: the spec MUST NOT price, promise or mint $TRI; TRI_PAYABLE stays false
  until trust model, settlement path and mainnet are all live.

## Success Criteria

- `./target-bench/release/t27c test-report specs/automation/service_ledger.t27`
  exits 0 with 24 tests and 2 invariants proved, vacuous 0.
- `./target-bench/release/t27c seal --verify` exits 0 for all three specs.
- `t27c validate-seals --pr-files specs/automation/service_ledger.t27,specs/automation/token-wallet.t27,specs/verified/payout.t27` exits 0.

## How to verify

```bash
./target-bench/release/t27c test-report specs/automation/service_ledger.t27
./target-bench/release/t27c seal --verify specs/automation/service_ledger.t27
./target-bench/release/t27c seal --verify specs/automation/token-wallet.t27
./target-bench/release/t27c seal --verify specs/verified/payout.t27
```

## Risks

DESIGN, no host yet: COMPLETION_HOST_EXISTS=false, BOOKS_HOST_EXISTS=false,
LIVE=false, TRI_PAYABLE=false. Must not be sold as live until a host splits a
real charge and a real completion runs through these functions.

## Links (issue, PR, ADR)

- Owner decisions 2026-10-23 (trace in service_ledger.t27 header)
- Host: gHashTag/999-multibots-telegraf (billing-shared.ts, token-ledger.ts)
- Network law: gHashTag/trinity-fpga specs/trinet/settlement_law.t27

comments.text:
Closed by the issue-shape gate (specs/policy/issue_shape.t27, #7498): an issue must have the template's sections. Edit the body; an edit that passes reopens it.

- missing: ## Boundary -- list every file this task may touch, one per line (`- specs/x.t27`); without it the Queen reserves nothing and no bee can take the issue
- missing: ## User Scenarios -- at least one Given/When/Then scenario
- missing: ## Requirements -- numbered obligations, `FR-001: ... MUST ...`
- missing: ## Success Criteria -- an outcome a machine can settle: a number with a unit, a backticked file, `exit 0`, or a backticked command
